# Accurate Pathology Laboratory

> Pathology lab on Mohammad Wadi Road, Sayyad Nagar (Mohammadwadi, Hadapsar, Pune), open 24×7. Blood tests at home, health checkup packages from ₹299, a Full Body Profile (85 parameters) at ₹1800, a Monsoon Fever Panel (32 parameters, reports in 4 hours) and a Hormonal Evaluation (12 tests). Reports on WhatsApp. "Trusted Reports | Better Health".

All types of blood tests are done here. Home sample collection is available on all packages; it is free for the Monsoon Fever Panel. Tests are for diagnostic purposes. Consult your doctor for interpretation.

## Health checkup packages

- [Complete Mini 1 — ₹299](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/complete-mini-1): Sugar, Cholesterol, Thyroid, GP Kidney Test, CBC
- [Complete Mini 2 — ₹599](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/complete-mini-2): CBC, Sugar (Fasting), RFT, Lipid Profile, Urine Routine
- [Complete Mini 3 — ₹999](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/complete-mini-3): CBC, Sugar Fasting, LFT, RFT, Lipid Profile, Iron Profile, HbA1c, TFT, Urine Routine
- [Complete Advance — ₹1499](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/complete-advance): Mini 3 tests (without urine) plus Vitamin B12 and Vitamin D3
- [Complete Gym Pro — ₹3399](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/complete-gym-pro): adds Hs-CRP, Homocysteine and Testosterone Total
- [Full Body Profile, 85 parameters — ₹1800 (MRP ₹2500)](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/full-body-profile): 10–12 hours fasting compulsory
- [Monsoon Fever Panel Advanced, 32 parameters — call for price](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/monsoon-fever-panel): Dengue NS1, Dengue IgG/IgM, Malaria antigen, Typhoid IgG/IgM, CBC, CRP, ESR; reports within 4 hours
- [Hormonal Evaluation, 12 tests — ₹2800](https://www.accuratepathologylaboratory.in/packages/hormonal-evaluation): Thyroid profile, AMH, FSH, LH, Prolactin, Estradiol, Progesterone, Testosterone, Free Testosterone, SHBG
